name: ecommerce-platform
description: Full-stack E-Commerce Web Application with React, Express, PostgreSQL, and Razorpay

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.build: cd client && npm run build && cd ../server && npm run build
scripts.db:migrate: cd server && npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:seed: cd server && npx prisma db seed
scripts.db:reset: cd server && npx prisma migrate reset --force
